notes: cics-crucible hex-attributes / hx-attr-bytes (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): raw 3270 attribute bytes in a BMS symbolic map (names, hex literals, bit arithmetic), DATAONLY / MAPONLY, RECEIVE MAP RESP. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: first-display
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: FIRST-SCREEN fills every attribute byte (name, hex literals, bit arithmetic, DFHBMEOF), SEND MAP ERASE, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: echo-dataonly
scenarios.why: second task (EIBCALEN 1), ENTER: ECHO-SCREEN, RECEIVE MAP normal (RESP NORMAL arm), STAT 'RECEIVED', SEND MAP DATAONLY

scenarios.name: clear-maponly
scenarios.why: second task, CLEAR: RESET-SCREEN, SEND MAP MAPONLY ERASE, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: pa-key-mapfail
scenarios.why: second task, PA1 (not CLEAR): ECHO-SCREEN, a PA key transmits no data so RECEIVE MAP gives MAPFAIL: the 'NO INPUT' arm

scenarios.name: all-fields
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): every input field filled, so each ECHO-SCREEN attribute-byte move is observed

scenarios.name: one-rawi
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): only RAWI received, isolating that field attribute

scenarios.name: one-twiddlei
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): only TWIDDLEI received, isolating that field attribute

scenarios.name: one-nulatri
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): only NULATRI received, isolating that field attribute

scenarios.name: one-leftovri
scenarios.why: survivor attack (#7955): only LEFTOVRI received, isolating that field attribute

scenarios.name: aid-pen
scenarios.why: a light-pen AID (DFHPEN) with data: the AID byte is compared against the named AIDs, not just ENTER/CLEAR/PA

scenarios.name: recv-invreq
scenarios.why: RECEIVE MAP answers INVREQ (RESP2 default): the program takes its error arm instead of reading the screen

scenarios.name: recv-invmpsz
scenarios.why: RECEIVE MAP answers INVMPSZ: a second RECEIVE MAP condition besides INVREQ and MAPFAIL, sent to the same arm

scenarios.name: eibcalen-zero-enter
scenarios.why: #7955: EIBCALEN 0 though the COMMAREA record is passed (X23): the first-display arm runs and the area is cut

scenarios.name: dto-entry-echo
scenarios.why: #7955: the echo-dataonly input through the typed DTO alone

scenarios.name: dto-entry-clear
scenarios.why: #7955: clear through the typed DTO alone

scenarios.name: send-map-invreq-erase
scenarios.why: #7955: SEND MAP ERASE answers INVREQ with no RESP: the condition is raised

scenarios.name: send-map-invreq-dataonly
scenarios.why: #7955: SEND MAP DATAONLY answers INVREQ with no RESP
